propositions: A new plan-review criterion ac-process-gate must detect and flag acceptance criteria whose completion predicate is a generic, ticket-agnostic mechanical process or tooling gate (e.g., all tests pass, children closed, plan-review passes, CI green) that CI or rebar enforces identically for every ticket.

The ac-process-gate criterion must accept (pass without finding) any AC that names or depends on the ticket's specific deliverable—artifact, behavior, contract, test, doc, config, or criterion the ticket produces—even when tests or plan-review are the subject.

The ac-process-gate criterion ships as a 1-TURN, advisory, non-codebase-grounded member of CANONICAL_LLM with ac-text-quality facet, container+leaf scope, and a two-key routing checklist (not-applicable gate and per-AC deliverable judgment).

The ac-process-gate rubric prompt must enumerate the reject-set (children-closed, tests/CI/build/lint pass, plan-review passes, completion-verifier passes, merged/landed, commit-trailer/DCO) and accept-set (ticket-specific deliverables), document the litmus (reads identically on arbitrary unrelated ticket), and enforce anti-false-positive silence.

Live bounded-sanity evaluation run on the committed fire/no-fire corpus (>=2 process-gate positives, >=2 deliverable negatives, <=8 total cases) achieves recall=1.0, false_accept=0.0, kappa=1.0 with production Bedrock model.
